_source: DECISIONS.md 2026-10-25, 'Wireless energy' (the user's design of 19:25 and 19:30): one global network, stored in Wireless Energy Towers whose capacitor cells set its size and its voltage; wireless energy and dynamo hatches at 2, 4, 16 and 64 A and wireless energy and dynamo covers, LV to IV; 5% lost on the way in. Capacities follow GTM 7.5.3's Power Substation (a cell holds six of its tier's batteries: PowerSubstationMachine / BatteryBlock.BatteryPartType, EV = 6 lapotron crystals); here six of the tier's reference battery (GTItems: LV and MV and HV lithium, EV small vanadium, IV medium vanadium, LuV large vanadium). The LuV row: docs/eras/luv.md, 'Power on the wireless network' and '3. HTS magnet works' (package LuV-A4): its cell is a superconducting magnetic energy storage (SMES) coil wound in the HTS magnet works.
_how_it_is_used: Read by startup_scripts/grindless/lv/wireless_energy.js (global.grindless.wireless.table): the cell blocks, the hatches, the covers and the tower; by server_scripts/grindless/lv/wireless_energy.js: the settlement, the readout and every recipe; by the smoke test tools/test/overlay/kubejs/server_scripts/gg_test_wireless_energy.js. Nothing here is repeated in code: a new row is a new tier of cells, hatches and covers (the rows go 1, 2, 3... with no gap).

tiers[]: one row per voltage tier (1 = LV ... 5 = IV, 6 = LuV, 7 = ZPM, 8 = UV, 9 = UHV, 10 = UEV). cell = the cell block of that tier and capacity its EU (referenceCount x reference battery, 6 when the row has no referenceCount; the UHV row: 24 of GTM's UV naquadria battery, four UV cells' worth, docs/eras/uhv.md 'Power' and S0-5: GTM's tier 9 battery is its MAX battery, Long.MAX_VALUE, no reference; the UEV row: 96 of the same battery, four UHV cells' worth, 251,658,240,000 EU, docs/eras/uev.md 'Power on the wireless network': GTM's tier 10 battery is Long.MAX_VALUE too); the cell recipe takes 6 of the tier's batteries (any battery of the tag), a frame, plates and circuits. emitter / sensor = what the wireless blocks of that tier take (EV takes HV ones: GTM's EV emitter and sensor need a quantum eye, radon, IV; UHV takes two UV ones, signalParts 2: GTM 7.5.3 has no UHV emitter or sensor without its high-tier content, uhv-s0.md S0-1; UEV takes one grindless:uev_emitter / uev_sensor, UEV-F1's, GTM has none). link = the tier's 'ender' part. plate / frame = the tier's hull metal. wire = the tier's cable metal (GTM: tin, copper, gold, aluminium, platinum, niobium-titanium): the 4, 16 and 64 A hatches add its quadruple, octal and hex wires, GTM's way (energy_input_hatch_4a / 16a).

cellMadeBy (optional): the machine that makes the row's cell instead of the assembler; the server script then adds no assembler recipe for it, and batteries / frame are not used (null). The LuV SMES cell is wound in gtceu:hts_magnet_works (circuit 2, tables/hts_magnet_works.json: its recipe's output is this row's cell; a Node test keeps the two in step); the ZPM, UV, UHV and UEV SMES cells in gtceu:naquadria_magnet_works (circuits 1, 4, 5 and 6, tables/magnet_works.json; docs/eras/uv.md, 'Power', package UV-A9: the UV row's link is GTM's gravi star; docs/eras/uhv.md, 'Power', package UHV-A9: the UHV row's link is our grindless:nuclear_clock; docs/eras/uev.md, package UEV-W: the UEV row's link is our grindless:quantum_repeater_node, the other link that is not GTM's or vanilla's). GTM has no rhodium-plated palladium frame and no LuV battery tag. texture (optional): the cell's block texture; default grindless:block/wireless/capacitor_cell_<name> (tools/assets/Build-WirelessEnergyTextures.ps1 draws both).

hatchAmps: the amperages of the wireless energy and dynamo hatches; coverAmps: the covers'. settleTicks: the settlement period (GTM 7.5.3's input hatch holds 16 ticks of its full rate, EnergyHatchPartMachine: V x 16 x A; every 10 ticks leaves 6 ticks to spare). loss: what reaches the network of every EU that goes in (19/20).

The network's tier is the lowest tier among the cells of every formed tower (an empty cell slot holds the tower's casing and counts for nothing); hatches and covers above it get nothing. Energy going in is not tier-limited.
